company_profile: NielsenIQ is a consumer intelligence company that measures retail sales and consumer buying behaviour for brands and retailers in 100+ markets.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years turning large, imperfect datasets into reliable methods and measurable results across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds Python, Pandas and PySpark data processing pipelines, statistical models for prediction, trend analysis and anomaly detection, and clear dashboards for stakeholders. Also applies GenAI and agentic workflows to automate data processing, taking prototypes to production with Docker and MLflow. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Retail Sales Trend Estimation
bullets: Built a trend-estimation pipeline for retail sales panels with incomplete store coverage, reweighting samples and imputing missing outlets with gradient boosting in PySpark and Pandas.
Validated estimates against held-out stores with unit-tested checks and bias diagnostics, then packaged the pipeline as a command-line tool in Docker for scheduled runs on Azure.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in the Data Science Methods team. For eight years my work has sat where your team works: turning large, imperfect datasets into methods that other teams can trust and run without me. That thread runs from healthcare audit reporting to telecom KPI analysis.

NIQ measures what people actually buy, and the quality of that picture depends on how carefully gaps and bias in the data are handled. That kind of methodological work, where a careful correction changes a retailer's decision, is what draws me. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Warsaw together and settle there long term.

I would focus on prototyping and automating statistical procedures in Python and Spark. At Viavi I built anomaly detection and Holt-Winters forecasting on 15+ KPIs across 500+ network devices, and earlier I automated medical-audit reporting with SQL and PySpark, cutting manual effort by 95%. Both taught me to document methods so operations teams can rely on them.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with teachers has taught me to test an idea with the people who depend on it before calling it done. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to your team.
